dvids.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Blockade
dvids.desc: U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman, Oct. 10, after the ship’s crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to run the ongoing naval blockade against Iran. (U.S. Central Command Video)

dvids.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Blockade
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces disabled a commercial cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman, Oct. 10, after the ship’s crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to run the ongoing naval blockade against Iran.

dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. – The Rear Admiral Edwin T. Layton Leadership Award was presented to Cmdr. Benjamin DeWitt, collections and targets department head, U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet (NAVCENT/C5F), Sept. 16, 2026.

dvids.title: US, Sweden, Finland reaffirm trilateral interoperability during historic Gulf of Bothnia transit
dvids.desc: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Paul Ignatius (DDG 117) completed a historic multi-day maritime transit through the Baltic Sea and the Gulf of Bothnia, arriving in Helsinki Oct. 8 following a successful port visit to Stockholm.
